campaignTitle: The Relic of the Four Realms

chapters.title: Whispers in the Emerald Wilds
chapters.storyArc: Rennie follows an old map into a living jungle and learns that the relic is a promise, not a prize.

scenes.title: The Forgotten Trail
scenes.environment: sunlit jungle trail, towering trees, drifting pollen, distant waterfall
scenes.objective: Follow the trail to the broken stone marker
scenes.story: At dawn, Rennie enters the Emerald Wilds with a weathered map left by his grandfather.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: The map ends here. The rest must be hidden in the forest.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: Listen to the birds. The old path is still alive.

scenes.title: The Three Lost Relics
scenes.environment: mossy clearing, giant roots, sunbeams, three ancient relic stones
scenes.story: Three stones hold the first clue. Their symbols glow when brought together.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: Each stone remembers a piece of the story.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: Then we will put the story back together.

scenes.title: The River Crossing
scenes.environment: shallow turquoise river, stepping stones, hanging vines, spray in the sunlight
scenes.objective: Cross the river and reach the far bank
scenes.story: The river blocks the trail. Rennie spots safe stones and a vine bridge worn by time.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: Take your time. The river rewards patience.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: One step, one breath. We cross together.

scenes.title: The Cave of Echoes
scenes.environment: fern-covered cave entrance, carved lintel, blue fireflies, warm relic glow
scenes.objective: Reach the cave door and reveal the first seal
scenes.story: The three stones open a hidden cave. A symbol on the door matches the map's oldest mark.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: This is only the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: Then let the first seal guide the way forward.

chapters.title: Secrets Beneath the Sand
chapters.storyArc: Beneath a desert city, Rennie discovers that the relic was protected to keep its power from being misused.

scenes.title: The Sunken Gate
scenes.environment: golden dunes, half-buried archway, heat shimmer, distant sandstone towers
scenes.objective: Find the entrance to the buried city
scenes.story: The first seal points across the desert to a city swallowed by sand.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: The wind has hidden this place for centuries.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: But it could not hide it forever.

scenes.title: The Three Sun Seals
scenes.environment: sunlit sandstone hall, mirrored shafts of light, carved floor puzzle
scenes.story: The city tests observation rather than strength; each seal redirects a beam toward the central door.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: The answer is in how the light moves.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: The builders left us a lesson, not a trap.

scenes.title: The Hall of Names
scenes.environment: vast sandstone library, painted murals, dust motes, broken shelves and statues
scenes.objective: Read the mural and locate the hidden passage
scenes.story: A mural tells of guardians who divided the relic's path so no single ruler could claim it.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: They were protecting people from the relic.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: Remember that when you finally reach it.

scenes.title: The Gate Below
scenes.environment: descending stairwell, underground blue pool, giant bronze door and three glowing sockets
scenes.objective: Place the seals and open the lower gate
scenes.story: The seals open a stairway into the mountain, where the next clue waits beyond an ancient gate.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: The city is behind us. There is no turning back now.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: We go forward, and we remember why.

chapters.title: The Shattered Mountain
chapters.storyArc: Rennie reunites fragments of the relic and faces the cost of pursuing a legend.

scenes.title: The Cliffside Path
scenes.environment: high mountain path, pine forest, cloud sea, rope bridges and distant peaks
scenes.story: A narrow path climbs above the clouds. The fragments react to a beacon on the summit.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: The summit beacon is older than the city below.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: Then it has been waiting a long time.

scenes.title: The Five Fragments
scenes.environment: crystal cavern, fractured pillars, reflective pools and five floating fragments
scenes.story: The relic was split into fragments so its power could not be controlled by one person.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: Every fragment carries the same light.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: And every choice we make changes what that light becomes.

scenes.title: The Guardian's Memory
scenes.environment: ancient observatory, rotating star map, painted constellations and drifting embers
scenes.objective: Activate the observatory and witness the memory
scenes.story: An echo of the first guardian reveals that the relic amplifies the heart of whoever carries it.

dialogue.speaker: Guardian Echo
dialogue.line: Power does not make a person worthy. It reveals what was already there.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: Then I must be honest about what I want.

scenes.title: The Storm Bridge
scenes.environment: broken bridge over a deep ravine, lightning beyond the peaks, glowing summit beacon
scenes.objective: Cross the storm bridge and reach the final realm
scenes.story: The restored fragments reveal the route to the Heart, but a storm threatens the final crossing.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: The bridge will not hold forever.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: Then we cross for everyone who kept this secret safe.

chapters.title: The Heart of the Relic
chapters.storyArc: Rennie reaches the source of the relic's power and chooses to protect the world rather than possess it.

scenes.title: The Hidden Sanctuary
scenes.environment: overgrown sanctuary, luminous pools, giant roots around white stone pillars
scenes.objective: Enter the sanctuary and find the heart-shards
scenes.story: The last realm is quiet and beautiful, guarded by nature rather than armies.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: This place feels alive.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: Maybe it is waiting to see what we choose.

scenes.title: The Four Heart-Shards
scenes.environment: circular chamber, four floating heart-shards, waterfalls and luminous vines
scenes.objective: Find four heart-shards and restore the central seal
scenes.story: The final fragments respond only when placed in balance, revealing the relic's true purpose.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: It is not asking us to take it.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: It is asking us to understand it.

scenes.title: The Heart's Trial
scenes.environment: grand circular arena, floating stone rings, beams of teal light and drifting petals
scenes.objective: Complete the guardian trial without losing the path
scenes.story: The guardian tests Rennie's resolve. The relic answers compassion more strongly than force.

dialogue.speaker: Guardian Echo
dialogue.line: Will you claim the heart, even if the world must pay?

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: No. A treasure that harms everyone belongs to no one.

scenes.title: A Light Shared
scenes.environment: sanctuary at sunrise, restored garden, petals in the air and a warm horizon
scenes.objective: Return the relic to the sanctuary and complete the journey
scenes.story: Rennie returns the relic to its resting place. Its light spreads across every realm, restoring what the journey touched.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.line: You found the treasure.

dialogue.speaker: Rennie
dialogue.line: We found something better. A reason to protect it.
